qualifier: RB-E2F G1/S and cyclin B-Cdk1 G2/M checkpoints
name: RB-E2F G1/S and Cdk1 G2/M transition control
rationale: All members concern control of mitotic cell cycle transitions, spanning both RB/E2F/CDK4-6 G1/S restraint and Chk1/PLK/MASTL G2/M control, unlike confusables limited to E2F target transcription, p53/DNA damage signaling or generic cell cycle modules.

qualifier: phagocytosis and inhibitory immunoreceptor control
name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis and inhibitory immunoreceptor signaling
rationale: Members cover FCGR activation, Fc-gamma-mediated phagocytosis and ADCC plus inhibitory receptor signaling (CD22, SIRP, negative BCR/B cell regulation), distinguishing it from the Fc-epsilon/mast cell and generic myeloid inflammation confusables.

qualifier: proximal-distal patterning and distal tubule segments
name: Nephron patterning and distal tubule segment development
rationale: All members describe metanephric nephron formation from renal vesicle to segment-specific tubules, and the distal tubule, loop of Henle and collecting duct members are what the ureteric bud and nephric duct confusables lack.

qualifier: methylmalonyl-CoA mutase in propionyl-CoA catabolism
name: Cobalamin-dependent methylmalonyl-CoA mutase in propionate catabolism
rationale: Members concern cobalamin metabolism feeding the MUT/MMAA/MMAB methylmalonyl-CoA mutase step of propionyl-CoA catabolism and its methylmalonic acidemias, whereas confusables cover cobalamin transport/MMACHC defects or branched-chain and biotin disorders.

qualifier: early myeloid-erythroid progenitor stage
name: Hematopoietic stem and early myeloid-erythroid progenitor regulation
rationale: Members regulate HSC homeostasis, proliferation and commitment into myeloid and erythroid progenitors (including RUNX1 and promyelocyte programmes), distinguishing it from confusables on terminal erythroid/megakaryocyte maturation or bone marrow B cell niches.

qualifier: linkage-specific K48/K63/K11 chain removal by DUB families
name: Linkage-specific ubiquitin chain removal by deubiquitinases
rationale: Members are DUB families (USP, OTU, JAMM) and K48/K63/K11-linked deubiquitination or its regulation, unlike confusables on neddylation, atypical chain polymerization or NF-kappaB control.

qualifier: semaphorin and netrin repulsion with axon regeneration and sprouting
name: Semaphorin and netrin repulsion in axon extension and regeneration
rationale: Members center on Sema3A-plexin and netrin repulsive signaling controlling axon extension, collateral sprouting and peripheral regeneration, lacking the ROBO, ephrin and L1 adhesion components of the broader guidance confusables.

qualifier: repression via nucleolar chromatin
name: Nucleolar chromatin silencing of RNA polymerase I transcription
rationale: All three members concern negative regulation of rRNA transcription through nucleolar chromatin (SIRT1), whereas confusables cover Pol I initiation, elongation, termination or rRNA processing.

qualifier: Th2 differentiation and IL-4/IL-5/IL-13 production control
name: Th2 differentiation and IL-4/IL-5/IL-13 production control
rationale: Members regulate Th2 differentiation, type 2 cytokine production, IgE switching and mast cell activation, without the eosinophil, IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 receptor signaling or Fc-epsilon mast cell pathways of the confusables.

qualifier: platelet degranulation with inhibition of fibrinolysis
name: Platelet degranulation and inhibition of fibrinolysis
rationale: Members combine platelet activation/degranulation with negative regulation of fibrinolysis and plasminogen activation, whereas confusables cover coagulation cascade, platelet receptor signaling or integrin/matrix adhesion.

qualifier: initiation and its negative regulation
name: Initiation and restraint of mitotic DNA replication
rationale: Members concern cell cycle DNA replication initiation, its negative regulation and E2F1 replication targets, unlike confusables on pre-RC assembly steps, S-phase damage checkpoints or broad E2F G1/S transcription.

qualifier: heme degradation through hepatic uptake, conjugation and excretion
name: Heme-to-bilirubin catabolism and hepatic bilirubin clearance
rationale: Members cover heme degradation, SLCO1B hepatic uptake, UGT1A conjugation and ABCC2 export with their hereditary hyperbilirubinemias, distinguishing it from xenobiotic and drug ADME transport confusables.

qualifier: mRNA, ribosomal subunit and tRNA cargoes
name: Nuclear export of mRNA, ribosomal subunits and tRNA
rationale: Members concern nucleocytoplasmic transport of mature mRNAs, pre-ribosomal subunits and tRNA, whereas confusables cover mRNA 3'-end and histone mRNA processing or nuclear pore assembly.

qualifier: NOTCH1/2 activation and oncogenic constitutive NOTCH1 mutants
name: NOTCH1/2 activation and oncogenic constitutive NOTCH1 signaling
rationale: Members describe NOTCH1 and NOTCH2 activation, NICD1 transcription and cancer-associated constitutive NOTCH1/FBXW7 defects, unlike confusables centered on NOTCH3/4, receptor processing or Notch-HLH targets.

qualifier: mammary, prostate and reproductive tract
name: Mammary, prostate and reproductive tract glandular development
rationale: Members concern development of mammary and prostate glandular epithelium and the uterus, vagina, oviduct and genitalia, distinguishing it from lung/salivary branching, kidney and gonad determination confusables.

core: Congenital disorders of glycosylation type I
qualifier: ALG glycosyltransferase defects in lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly
name: ALG glycosyltransferase defects in lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly
rationale: Every member is a CDG-I caused by an ALG glycosyltransferase extending the dolichol-linked oligosaccharide, whereas confusables are defects in mannose/dolichol donor synthesis (PMM2, DPM, DOLK) or other glycosylation steps.

qualifier: growth plate proliferation and hypertrophic maturation
name: Growth plate chondrocyte proliferation and hypertrophic maturation
rationale: Members regulate chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation, hypertrophy and RUNX2-driven maturation in the growth plate, unlike confusables on early chondroblast condensation or osteoblast and bone formation.

qualifier: olfactory receptor odorant and pheromone sensing
name: Olfactory receptor-mediated odorant and pheromone perception
rationale: All members concern olfactory receptors and the sensing of odorants and pheromones, distinguishing the theme from the taste perception confusables.

qualifier: P450 epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase and 12-lipoxygenase routes
name: P450 epoxygenase/hydroxylase and 12-lipoxygenase fatty acid oxygenation
rationale: Members cover cytochrome P450 epoxygenase and omega-hydroxylase products (EET, HETE) and 12-lipoxygenase hepoxilins, unlike confusables centered on 5-lipoxygenase leukotrienes or unrelated CYP-defect diseases.

qualifier: strand exchange, D-loop resolution and BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 defects
name: Homologous recombination strand exchange and BRCA-PALB2 defects
rationale: Members span end processing, RAD51 strand exchange, D-loop resolution and BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 loss-of-function, distinguishing it from NHEJ/DSB-sensing confusables and resection/MMEJ-only confusables.

qualifier: type II Na/Pi cotransporters and FGFR1c-Klotho signaling
name: Phosphate homeostasis via type II Na/Pi cotransporters and FGFR-Klotho
rationale: Members concern sodium-phosphate cotransport (SLC34A1/A3 and their hypophosphatemias), PTH and FGFR1c-Klotho signaling and bone mineralization, unlike vitamin D, dentin or SLC34A2-only confusables.

qualifier: ductal branching, alveologenesis and lactation
name: Mammary ductal branching, alveologenesis and lactation
rationale: Members cover mammary ductal elongation and branching, alveolar development and lactation, which the confusables built on luminal/myoepithelial/stem lineages or involution lack.

qualifier: methionine-SAM cycle and its inherited enzyme defects
name: Methionine-S-adenosylmethionine cycle and its inherited defects
rationale: Members concern methionine and SAM metabolism and MAT1A, AHCY, MTR and MTRR deficiencies, unlike confusables on selenium and methionine salvage, carnitine/choline or folate metabolism.

qualifier: NLRP1/NLRP3 IL-1 processing and chemokine production
name: NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome IL-1 processing and chemokine production
rationale: Members link NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasomes and IL-1 precursor processing with IL-1 alpha and CXCL1/2, CCL5, MIP-1 alpha production, lacking the pyroptosis/IL-18, IL-17 and TLR signaling of the confusables.

qualifier: renin-angiotensin and vasoactive peptide control of natriuresis
name: Renin-angiotensin and vasoactive peptide control of natriuresis and pressure
rationale: Members cover angiotensin generation and signaling, bradykinin/neuropeptide catabolism and guanylyl cyclase cGMP control of renal sodium excretion and blood pressure, unlike confusables on nitric oxide and vascular smooth muscle contraction.
